digest.component_or_area: plan-review reviewer prompts and criteria routing
propositions: Dual vocabulary of 'Success Criteria' and 'Acceptance Criteria' in reviewer prompts conflates two distinct headings into a single pooled bar, creating noise in rubrics and generated criteria guides.

All occurrences of 'success criterion/criteria' must be renamed to 'acceptance criterion/criteria' across reviewer prompts and the criteria routing index, with explicit exceptions for T2's generic pilot-metrics wording and DOD uncertifiable definitions.
The criteria routing index edit rotates the regver stamp, invalidating outstanding attestations; this is safe only after ticket 1f32-f86e-8a51-4d8e's merge (grandfathering) has landed.
The generated criteria guide must be regenerated from the updated prompts and routing index, retaining its GENERATED banner and carrying exactly one 'success criteria' match (T2's excluded phrase).
Registry version must be demonstrated to rotate (differ pre- and post-edit) by capturing both stamps at runtime rather than hard-coded literals.
All lint, typecheck, and pytest suite tests must pass after the substitution and routing edit.
